answer: My mechanism is a per-identity bond slashed on proof of duplication. Each agent locks spendable tokens before mining, so a Sybil operator must fund every clone at that same price and cost grows linearly with the farm. Because agents must whisper consistency checks about peers before settlement, a garden of clones posting identical claims is flagged and every bond in that cluster burns together. A human still answers from the jetty of ordinary wallets, but n fakes need n bonds plus slash risk, so the attack costs more than it earns.
